kba-01:
devarājasevyamānapāvanāṅghripaṅkajaṃ vyālayajñasūtram induśekharaṃ kṛpākaram |
nāradādiyogivṛndavanditaṃ digambaraṃ kāśikāpurādhināthakālabhairavaṃ bhaje ||
kba-02:
bhānukoṭibhāsvaraṃ bhavābdhitārakaṃ paraṃ nīlakaṇṭham īpsitārthadāyakaṃ trilocanam |
kālakālam ambujākṣam akṣaśūlam akṣaraṃ kāśikāpurādhināthakālabhairavaṃ bhaje ||
kba-03:
śūlaṭaṅkapāśadaṇḍapāṇim ādikāraṇaṃ śyāmakāyam ādidevam akṣaraṃ nirāmayam |
bhīmavikramaṃ prabhuṃ vicitratāṇḍavapriyaṃ kāśikāpurādhināthakālabhairavaṃ bhaje ||
kba-04:
bhuktimuktidāyakaṃ praśastacāruvigrahaṃ bhaktavatsalaṃ sthitaṃ samastalokavigraham |
vinikvaṇanmanojñahemakiṅkiṇīlasatkaṭiṃ kāśikāpurādhināthakālabhairavaṃ bhaje ||
kba-05:
dharmasetupālakaṃ tv adharmamārganāśakaṃ karmapāśamocakaṃ suśarmadāyakaṃ vibhum |
svarṇavarṇaśeṣapāśaśobhitāṅgamaṇḍalaṃ kāśikāpurādhināthakālabhairavaṃ bhaje ||
kba-06:
ratnapādukāprabhābhirāmapādayugmakaṃ nityam advitīyam iṣṭadaivataṃ nirañjanam |
mṛtyudarpanāśanaṃ karāladaṃṣṭramokṣaṇaṃ kāśikāpurādhināthakālabhairavaṃ bhaje ||
kba-07:
aṭṭahāsabhinnapadmajāṇḍakośasaṃtatiṃ dṛṣṭipātanaṣṭapāpajālam ugraśāsanam |
aṣṭasiddhidāyakaṃ kapālamālikādharaṃ kāśikāpurādhināthakālabhairavaṃ bhaje ||
kba-08:
bhūtasaṃghanāyakaṃ viśālakīrtidāyakaṃ kāśivāsalokapuṇyapāpaśodhakaṃ vibhum |
nītimārgakovidaṃ purātanaṃ jagatpatiṃ kāśikāpurādhināthakālabhairavaṃ bhaje ||
kba-09:
kālabhairavāṣṭakaṃ paṭhanti ye manoharaṃ jñānamuktisādhanaṃ vicitrapuṇyavardhanam |
śokamohadainyalobhakopatāpanāśanaṃ prayānti kālabhairavāṅghrisannidhiṃ narā dhruvam ||
